citation: Engineering News, vol. 51, supplement, 23 and 30 June 1904: the contract notices of the U.S. Engineer Office, 1637 Indiana Ave., Chicago, dated 20 and 25 June 1904.
author: Engineering News
locator: The proposals columns: 'U. S. ENGINEER OFFICE, 1637 Indiana Ave., Chicago, Ill., June 20, 1904.—Sealed proposals ...' (23 June) and '... June 25, 1904' (30 June); Capt. C. S. Riche and Col. O. H. Ernst, Corps of Engineers.
rights_note: A US periodical published in 1904, in the public domain. Read for an address and a date.
access_notes: Found 2026-10-24 (T-3068) through the Internet Archive's full-text search for "1637 Indiana", which returns the same office's notices from 1896 through 1904 in Engineering News, The Marine Record, The Marine Review and The American Architect, and later into the 1920s.
note: Places a working office at 1637 Indiana Avenue five and ten days before the scene date. The Corps' Chicago district had used the address since at least May 1896; the Blue Book lists a household there in 1890 and 1894 and none after, so the brick house Robinson 1886 draws became the district's office.
what_it_supplies: a building in use at 1637 Indiana on 20 and 25 June 1904, the U.S. Engineer Office
what_it_does_not_supply: the building's form, height or plan
